Class SummaryCardOverlay

java.lang.Object
view.widgets.SummaryCardOverlay
public final class SummaryCardOverlay extends Object
Full-screen in-game overlay that shows one or more SummaryCard images. When multiple images are supplied, arrow buttons allow navigating between them without closing the overlay. Click anywhere on the dark backdrop to dismiss.

  • Method Details

    • show

      public static void show(javafx.scene.layout.StackPane root, javafx.scene.image.Image... images)
      Shows the overlay on top of root. Pass one image for the original single-card behaviour, or multiple images to enable arrow navigation between them. Must be called on the JavaFX Application Thread.
